sloka: देहीत्यन्यो ददात्यन्यो ददामीत्यपरः पुनः।किं क्लेशयसि तिष्ठेति तत्रान्योन्यं बभाषिरे ।। ६.७५.६७ ।।
transliteration: dehītyanyo dadātyanyo dadāmītyaparaḥ punaḥ।kiṁ kleśayasi tiṣṭheti tatrānyonyaṁ babhāṣire ।। 6.75.67 ।।

translations.english: There they conversed this way with one another 'One said hit me and another one offered to hit,', again another intervened and said, 'Why are you crying?' meaning I offer resistance, one said 'Why are you suffering like this?'.
translations.hindi: तब वीर गंवाक्ष को बड़ा आश्चय हुआ ओर वह बार बार गजने लगा । इंससे राक्षपश्रेष्ठ उन्मत्त अत्यन्त क्रुद्ध हुआ स उसने चमचमाती
